Name: Rephael, Son of Shemaiah
Summary: Son of Shemaiah son of Obed-edom, mighty man of valour.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 26:7: Son of Shemaiah son of Obed-edom, mighty man of valour.
LifeLesson: Named in the covenant line, Rephael stands among the individuals God placed within His people's story in 1 Chronicles.
